name: Windows — Office Application Spawned a Command Shell or Script Host
description: Detects a Microsoft Office application spawning a command shell or scripting host (cmd, PowerShell, wscript/cscript, mshta, rundll32, regsvr32). This parent-child relationship is a hallmark of malicious-macro / phishing-document execution.
note:
## Investigation
1. `process.parent.name` (Office app) spawned `process.name`.
2. Review `process.command_line` for the downloaded/executed payload.
3. Correlate with the source document and the user's recent email; check for follow-on network or PowerShell activity.
## Response
Isolate the host, capture the document, and reset the user's credentials if execution succeeded.
author: raadabujaish
query: event.code:"4688" and process.parent.name:("winword.exe" or "excel.exe" or "powerpnt.exe" or "outlook.exe" or "onenote.exe" or "msaccess.exe") and process.name:("cmd.exe" or "powershell.exe" or "pwsh.exe" or "wscript.exe" or "cscript.exe" or "mshta.exe" or "rundll32.exe" or "regsvr32.exe" or "bitsadmin.exe" or "certutil.exe")
